title: OER: parse extensions in SEQUENCE and CHOICE definitions
description:
OER extension parsing was not implemented, now it is.
It is possible to parse the extensions which are known in the grammar, and extensions which are not yet known.

Example containing both SEQUENCE and CHOICE extensions is attached.
Attached 
[p2p_cert_reply.pcap](/uploads/237bf9afbc20a3f938cd06ed1522bd91/p2p_cert_reply.pcap)
